ModMetaData.name: Convergence: Furniture
ModMetaData.author: Prospero1088
ModMetaData.description:
Feng shui, sect furniture and lighting for Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
Carved screens, vases, censers, koi ponds, rock gardens, statues of the four sacred beasts, sect beds and tables, wardrobes, scripture shelves, spirit wine jars, paper and spirit stone lanterns and glow crystals. Each piece adds qi and an element to the room it is in. Nothing needs electricity.
Requires Convergence: Era of Cultivation.
